title: Belgian Waffles

items: 2 cups (241g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1 ½ teaspoons baking powder (optional for 30 minute variation)

steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl, leaving room for expansion; the mixture will bubble and grow.  Include the baking powder for the 30 minute quick version, otherwise skip it.
Stir to combine; it's OK if the mixture isn't perfectly smooth.
Cover with plastic wrap and rest according to the following schedule:
Best (Yeast only):  Rest overnight in the refrigerator.
Good/Fast (Yeast Only):  Rest at room temperature for 1 hour.
Fastest (Yeast + Baking Powder):  Rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat your waffle iron to 400 °F on Griddle mode.
Pour 1 heaping cup (~ 1.2 cups) onto the center of the griddle and level sleightly with the back of the measuring cup.  Close the lid and bake for 4 minutes, until the waffle is golden brown.
Remove and rest on a wire cooling rack to prevent sogginess.  Serve immediately with syrup or dusted with powder sugar.
reviewFlags: Used baking powder for the quick variation to match the ingredients and mixing instructions.
